mapper.select: SELECT rql.id, rql.role_id AS roleId, rql.quota_per_day AS quotaPerDay, rql.tokens_per_q AS tokensPerQ, rql.tokens_per_day AS tokensPerDay, rql.can_configure_api_key AS canConfigureApiKey, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode FROM role_quota_limits rql INNER JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = rql.role_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_quota_limits (role_id, quota_per_day, tokens_per_q, tokens_per_day, can_configure_api_key) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{quotaPerDay}, #{tokensPerQ}, #{tokensPerDay}, #{canConfigureApiKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quota_per_day = VALUES(quota_per_day), tokens_per_q = VALUES(tokens_per_q), tokens_per_day = VALUES(tokens_per_day), can_configure_api_key = VALUES(can_configure_api_key)
